title: Oil Barrel
summary: Oil barrel explodes when ignited, dealing 6d6 Fire and knocking creatures back.

fields.Throw: Action. The 88 lb barrel needs at least Strength 15 to throw. Range depends on Strength and weight, up to 60 ft. Breaking the barrel spills Oil in a 20 ft radius. The Oil surface has 1 HP. Throw or place it on Fire to detonate it.
fields.Explosion: 20 ft radius, 6d6 Fire. Dexterity save DC 12 halves damage. The blast knocks targets back 10 ft without a save.
fields.Surface: Oil itself has no movement penalty. Igniting the spill creates a Fire surface that deals 1d4 Fire per turn and applies Burning for 1 turn.
fields.Acquisition: Found at locations including the Goblin Camp, Waukeen’s Rest and the Selûnite Outpost.
fields.Base value: 5 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
